record: C7 Stage 2 — crash classification and resume authorization

what_happened.symptom: 5 cells reported rc=1 after ~204 minutes each; 0 cells marked done
what_happened.root_cause: the identity-manifest block resolved its checkpoint path with a hardcoded g0_v5_long template while the policy-loading path above it was already arm-aware. 4v4 cells completed their full counterfactual measurement, wrote valid states, then died looking for a 3300001 checkpoint under the 2v2 directory.
what_happened.an_earlier_and_separate_failure: the first launch at 12 workers died instantly with MemoryError during checkpoint hashing; 4v4 workers need ~1.5GB each and 12 exceeded available RAM. Reduced to 6. That attempt produced 0 shards and 0 states.

why_this_is_not_INVALID_EXECUTION.the_rule: a defect invalidates a measurement only if it made the MEASURED quantity not the intended quantity
why_this_is_not_INVALID_EXECUTION.here: the defect occurred strictly AFTER measurement, in provenance generation. It could not have altered any collected state, utility or trajectory.
why_this_is_not_INVALID_EXECUTION.scientific_parameters_changed_by_the_fix: NONE. The fix makes a checkpoint-hash lookup arm-aware. It touches no seed, episode count, response enumeration, horizon, delta, support minimum or threshold.

checks_passed_for_all_five: policy key equals the cell's policy
every row carries the cell's opponent and no other
all 30 episode seeds lie inside the frozen block 9920000-9920029
60 states per cell (30 episodes x max_states 2)
distinct content hashes -- no cross-cell duplication

manifest_backfill.why_not_recompute: regenerating provenance would require re-running ~3.4 hours of valid measurement per cell, creating needless opportunity for divergence in data that verified clean
manifest_backfill.honest_limitation: states_file_sha256 becomes TAUTOLOGICAL for these five shards, since it is computed from the file it certifies. It no longer proves the file is unmodified since collection.
manifest_backfill.what_remains_meaningful: the six independent checks above, plus a checkpoint hash read from the real 4v4 checkpoint (321f14655934ac19)
manifest_backfill.merge_compatibility_verified: all eleven merger SHARED_KEYS match what the fixed code writes for a new cell, so the backfilled shards merge cleanly rather than aborting after the remaining run

corrected_cost_estimates.my_earlier_claim: ~40 hours, from a raw Cartesian response count of 57/state
corrected_cost_estimates.measured_pace: 5 cells retired at ~204 min on 6 workers
corrected_cost_estimates.revised: ~12 hours total, ~9 hours remaining with the five cells banked

resume_authorization.action: resume the SAME frozen experiment on the SAME block, reusing the five valid shards
resume_authorization.why_this_is_not_post_data_discretion: no parameter changes, no candidate selection, no sampling change, no seed change. This finishes the computation already specified by ba5b436. Shard resume is the architecture's designed behaviour, not a workaround.
resume_authorization.cells: 5 completed / 16 pending, reported explicitly by the launcher before work starts
unchanged: both arms under the identical protocol

the_bounded_2A_2B_design_is_retained_but: a sampled-discovery + fresh-confirmation scanner remains the right architecture for SRCTF and future larger-team evaluations, where exhaustive branching genuinely becomes unmanageable. It is NOT needed as an emergency replacement here, and adopting it now would have discarded valid data and spent a fresh block to avoid nine hours.
